channel.title: The Fetal Frontier
channel.description: A weekly peer-level digest of the most important new research in fetal and prenatal diagnosis and therapy, with Juno and Caspar.

item.title: Closed Spinal Dysraphism, Now With Numbers
item.description:
Closed spinal dysraphism — specifically limited dorsal myeloschisis — is a diagnosis where the prenatal counseling conversation has been running ahead of the outcome data for years. Athiel and colleagues just closed some of that distance. Two centers, ten years, seventy cases, standardized developmental follow-up at eighteen and thirty-six months. And the design is what earns it attention before we've even looked at the numbers. Prospective identification at pre...

Juno, Caspar, and any guest voices are AI-generated. Episode text and audio are generated with human-directed software.

Chapters:
  1. 0:00 — COLD OPEN: What Changed This Week
  2. 0:50 — HEADLINE: Study Design and Why It Earns the Evidence Grade
  3. 1:40 — HEADLINE: Functional Outcome Findings
  4. 2:30 — HEADLINE: Key Caveat — What n=70 Can and Cannot Support
  5. 3:20 — HEADLINE: Practice Impact
  6. 4:09 — ROUND 1: Galloway / ClinGen Prenatal Gene Curation
  7. 4:59 — ROUND 2: Munoz / Genetic Testing During TTTS Laser
  8. 5:49 — ROUND 3: Shinar / Fetal Intracranial Hemorrhage
  9. 6:39 — ROUND 4: Yu / Isolated Pelvic Kidney Genetic Yield
  10. 7:29 — CLOSE: What to Watch, What Remains Unsettled


Follow-up links:
  • Prenatal findings and postnatal outcomes in cases of closed spinal dysraphism: 10-year two-center cohort study. - Provides multicenter outcome data for a diagnostically challenging prenatal finding, anchoring counseling with concrete functional outcomes at 18 and 36 months.
  • Curating the Fetal Genome: Experience of the ClinGen Prenatal Gene Curation Expert Panel (GCEP). - International expert curation directly informs prenatal exome interpretation standards, providing an evidence-based framework for genomic counseling.
  • Opportunistic Prenatal Genetic Testing During Fetoscopic Laser Surgery for Twin-Twin Transfusion Syndrome. - Directly relevant to fetal therapy practice; demonstrates feasibility and uptake of genetic testing during an already-invasive procedure.
  • Fetal Intracranial Hemorrhage: What to Tell Expecting Parents? - Practical counseling framework for uncommon but high-stakes prenatal diagnosis, synthesizing classification, etiology, and neurodevelopmental outcomes.
  • Genetic Investigation of Pregnancies With an Isolated Fetal Pelvic Kidney. - Largest genetic workup series for isolated pelvic kidney; guides invasive testing counseling by demonstrating very low CMA yield.

item.title: When Blood Tests Might Replace the Needle
item.description:
This week's lead paper asks whether a blood test can replace the needle for monogenic diagnosis. The design is serious enough that we have to engage with it — blinded, prospective, amniocentesis as the reference standard, chromosomal and monogenic targets on the same platform. The specific patient this targets is a carrier couple — both partners carrying a pathogenic variant for the same single-gene condition — currently being counseled toward amniocentesis. Tha...

Juno, Caspar, and any guest voices are AI-generated. Episode text and audio are generated with human-directed software.

Chapters:
  1. 0:00 — Cold Open: The Clinical Question
  2. 0:45 — Headline: Citation and Design
  3. 1:30 — Headline: Effect Size and Target Population
  4. 2:15 — Headline: Caveats and Evidence Ceiling
  5. 3:01 — Headline: Practice Impact and What to Watch
  6. 3:46 — Rounds: Cruz-Martínez (BPS Laser Ablation)
  7. 4:31 — Rounds: Leonidou (Hemoglobinopathy NIPD)
  8. 5:16 — Rounds: Vaiküll (Fetal-Fraction Enrichment for CNV Detection)
  9. 6:01 — Rounds: Houri (Post-Fetoscopy PPROM Resistance Profiles)
  10. 6:46 — Close: What to Watch and What Remains Unsettled


Follow-up links:
  • Extended Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing for Chromosomal and Monogenic Disorders by Cell-Free DNA Sequencing: A Blinded Comparison With Amniocentesis - First large blinded prospective comparison showing cfDNA exome sequencing approaches amniocentesis accuracy for both chromosomal and monogenic disorders
  • Standardized Technique for Full Laser Ablation of Feeding Artery in Fetuses With Bronchopulmonary Sequestration and Large Pleural Effusion - Largest standardized prospective cohort for fetal BPS laser ablation; 96.6% survival with minimal postnatal morbidity
  • Non-Invasive Prenatal Diagnosis of Haemoglobinopathies: From Concept to Clinical Reality - Practical synthesis of NIPD methods for sickle cell and thalassemia, mapping implementation pathway for high-prevalence settings
  • Genome-Wide NIPT With Fetal-Fraction Enrichment and BinDel: Clinical Cohort Evaluation of Microdeletion and -Duplication Detection - Demonstrates fetal-fraction enrichment enables reliable CNV detection down to ~1 Mb across BMI groups in large real-world cohort
  • Microbial Culture Profiles Following Fetal Surgery Versus Spontaneous Preterm Prelabor Rupture of Membranes in Multifetal Gestations - Reveals distinct resistance patterns after fetoscopic procedures, informing empiric antibiotic selection post-fetal surgery
